comment: The Info docker is placed last, after the three recorded shots, because two of its sections carry numbers no two runs share. Build names the commit of the checkout that ran it, and GPU carries the composites' own timings, so a frame holding the docker differs from a run on another checkout by hundreds of texels and from a second run on the same one by hundreds more. Everything the scenario claims is in the dump, which reports the docker's rows whether it is open or not.
The Layers docker where G2 put it, which is the frame the three recorded shots are read against.
Plain Normal, whose dropdown label carries the document's space in brackets. The Info docker's Active layer row reads the same label, and the state beside the shot is where that is read.
A built-in whose id is not its name: normal_srgb is sRGB Normal in the dropdown.
The module's Hard Mix, picked from the Layers docker's own dropdown the way the scenario picks it.

The Info docker itself, grown so its last section, Active layer, is on screen without scrolling, beside the Layers docker. This shot is deliberately not recorded and has no picture under tests/shots: see the README there. The rows it shows are in 4-the-info-docker.json.
